explication: Hercules analyzes Git commit history through a configurable Go pipeline of analysis tasks, then emits YAML or Protocol Buffers for Labours, its Python plotting tool. The graph shows the documented workflow and major analysis capabilities, plus selected internal processing and embedding layers. Some analysis modules and CLI/reader wiring are unsampled; those subsystems are represented by their existing directories, and undocumented calls are omitted.
